title: Cast
style: Cinematic painted portrait for a real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer character art: dramatic rim light, rich colour, crisp detail, the face in the centre of a wide 16:9 frame with space on both sides, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional East African woman scientist in her forties, plain shirt and a grey cardigan, glasses pushed up into her hair, sitting in a small operations room full of glowing screens at night, lit by one warm amber desk lamp, thoughtful and kind, looking at the viewer.

Portrait of a fictional young woman commando from 1953 in her late twenties, dark hair tied back, 1950s fatigues and canvas webbing, rolled sleeves, a pistol holster, a confident half smile, standing in a concrete bunker lit by tungsten light, looking at the viewer.

Archival-style painted portrait of an elderly physicist in 1953 with wild white hair and a white moustache, grey cardigan, standing before a huge brass time machine glowing pale blue, gentle and worried, soft film grain, looking at the viewer.

A black-and-white 1950s formal portrait photograph in an ornate dark frame, where the man has been cut out of the print: a crisp man-shaped blank gap in the outline of a dark suit, only his gloved hands resting on a chair, the frame reflected in polished black glass, mysterious, no face visible.

Portrait of a fictional Iranian army engineer colonel in his fifties, close-cropped greying beard, sand-coloured field uniform with rolled sleeves and no badges, a dusty scarf, reading glasses in his breast pocket, standing beside a water tanker truck on a white salt flat at dusk, calm and practical, looking at the viewer.

Portrait of a fictional Israeli lieutenant colonel, a woman in her forties, dark hair in a low knot, plain olive uniform with no badges, a headset around her neck and binoculars on a strap, in a harbour command room lit by green screens, alert and sceptical, looking at the viewer.
